Intro.title: Custom Brokerage:
Intro.desc:
Customs declaration matters most to clients in Vietnam; and it does in other countries likewise. Our trustworthy and devoted professionals with knowledge and decades of local experience, especially commitment to integrity, ascertain to consult and get your shipment released as soon as possible. It takes around 6 to 8 working hours from landing for air freight and 2 working days for ocean freight from vessel unloading, provided that sufficient information is given accurately and promptly.

Moreover, our team is able to suggest customers quickly and exactly in declaration, truthfully, properly while leveraging the State incentive policies, for safeguarding importer and exporter interests and relief to customs officials.

On EDI platform and digitalized connectivity, we make sure your merchandise is released fast and smoothly.
